articles.title: Three News Groups Take Trump to Court Over White House Ban
articles.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are suing President Trump after he banned them from White House events. They say it's against the First Amendment. A judge will decide.

articles.title: Poland Says Russian Helicopter Flew Into Its Airspace for 42 Seconds
articles.summary: Poland says a Russian military helicopter crossed into its airspace on Wednesday for 42 seconds. Poland is part of NATO. It scrambled fighter jets in response.

articles.title: Harry Kane Wants to Try Kicking in the NFL!
articles.summary: England soccer captain Harry Kane says he might become an NFL kicker after he stops playing soccer. He's 33 and has scored 85 goals for England. He says kicking a football is a lot like taking a penalty.
